question: 只看分支 IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD 的 2013 年佣金收入是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2013 AND db.Branch = 'IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD' LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
过滤载体：分支名取 TPC-DI 变造实测值
